levels.name: Meet F1
levels.sol: f R f L f|F F F
levels.hint: Build three Forwards in the F1 row. Then use F1 in your program.

levels.name: F1 stairs
levels.sol: f f f f|F R F L
levels.hint: Put one stair in F1: Forward, turn right, Forward, turn left.

levels.name: Gem trips
levels.sol: f f f|F L F R R F L F
alt: f f f|F L F L L F L F
levels.hint: One trip to a gem and back goes in F1. Use it three times.

levels.name: Plus sign
levels.sol: f f R f f|F F L L F F
alt: f f f F F|F F R R F F L
levels.hint: In F1, go to the end of an arm and back. Which way is it facing then?

levels.name: Stairs and a step
levels.sol: f f F f f f|F L F R
levels.hint: One stair goes in F1. Use it, step along, then use it again.

levels.name: Turning stairs
levels.sol: f f f R f f f f|F R F L
levels.hint: F1 works whichever way the robot faces. Turn, then use it again.

levels.name: Gem alleys
levels.sol: f f F f|F R F L L F R F
alt: f f F f|F R F R R F R F
levels.hint: The alleys are not evenly spaced. An extra Forward fills the gap.

levels.name: Two gardens
levels.sol: f r4(F) f R r3(F)|r4(F F R)
levels.hint: Walking round a garden is the same each time. A Repeat fits in F1!

levels.name: Hook spiral
levels.sol: f L r3(f)|F F R F
levels.hint: The path is four hooks. Build one hook in F1. Is there an extra turn?

levels.name: Garden steps
levels.sol: f r3(f L)|F R F F
levels.hint: Every step down is the same piece. Which turn comes after each one?

levels.name: Two by two
levels.sol: r2(f L F f)|F R F F
levels.hint: Find the piece that comes four times. Two of them fit in each round!

levels.name: Bumpy slope
levels.sol: f F R r3(f)|F F R F L
levels.hint: Spot the piece that keeps coming back. One gap is different!

levels.name: Two pairs
levels.sol: r2(f F) L r2(f)|F F R F
levels.hint: The hooks come in pairs. What happens between the two pairs?

levels.name: Stair landing
levels.sol: f F f f|r2(F R F L)
levels.hint: Two stairs make one flight. Put a Repeat in F1. Where is the landing?

levels.name: Cog wheel
levels.sol: f r3(f F)|r2(F R F) L
alt: f r3(f F)|F R F F R F L
levels.hint: Each tooth of the cog is the same. Look for the steps between teeth!

levels.name: Wiggly road
levels.sol: r2(f) r2(f R F)|F R F L F
levels.hint: Every wiggle is the same. Do the wiggles come in twos?

levels.name: Three ponds
levels.sol: f r2(f F)|L r3(F F R) L
levels.hint: Round three sides of a pond is one F1. Look at the gaps between.

levels.name: Stair hook
levels.sol: f r2(f R) F f|r2(F R F L)
levels.hint: One staircase goes in F1. It comes four times, facing different ways.

levels.name: Stone arch
levels.sol: f F f f|r3(L F R F) R
levels.hint: Each staircase ends with a turn. Find the one gap that is different.

levels.name: Ring of stairs
levels.sol: f r3(f F)|R r3(L F R F)
levels.hint: Turn, then climb a staircase: that is F1. Which corners have a step?
